header.name: mc-test-lib return-value probes
header.description: What a call's return value reports when the action does not land: applyDamage across the amount range, under cancellation and under the invulnerability window; createExplosion under cancellation; and the isolated no-health damage set. Run /scriptevent mctest5:returns and mctest5:nohealth and copy the [mctest] lines.
